verdict.rationale: Circle's own docs name the stablecoins it supports (USDC, EURC, cirBTC on Gateway; USDC, EURC and registered third-party assets via CCTP). They also name some networks (EVM, Solana, Arc), and a CPN endpoint returns the supported currencies and blockchains. There is no evidence of USDT support, and no enumerated per-product chain matrix appears in the pack. Missing for 10: USDT or other non-Circle major stablecoin support, an explicit published list of supported chains per product, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold

citations.quote: Circle Gateway allows you to create a chain-abstracted USDC, EURC, or cirBTC balance and transfer it instantly to any supported destination chain.
extends to EURC and registered third-party assets through CCTP for non-USDC
balances, transfers, approvals on EVM and Solana
Returns the overview of supported countries, currencies, payment methods, blockchains.
